forum.title: Facing issue Debugging Stm32 Blue Pill
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome to the forum.

Please see *[How to write your question to maximize your chances to find a solution](https://community.st.com/t5/community-guidelines/how-to-write-your-question-to-maximize-your-chances-to-find-a/ta-p/575228 "How to write your question to maximize your chances to find a solution")* for best results - in particular, what other tools, etc, are you using?

Note that Blue Pill is **not an ST Product**, and [most likely contains a fake/clone microcontroller](https://hackaday.com/2020/10/22/stm32-clones-the-good-the-bad-and-the-ugly/).

Therefore, you most likely ***will*** face problems when trying to use it with ST tools - that's a given !

eg, see [this](https://community.st.com/t5/others-hardware-and-software/configuring-uart-on-stm32f103c8t6-bluepill-kills-connection-to/m-p/668641/highlight/true#M32234); and a [forum search for "Blue Pill"](https://community.st.com/t5/forums/searchpage/tab/message?filter=location&q=Blue%20Pill&location=forum-board:other-hardware-forum&sort_by=-topicPostDate&collapse_discussion=true) will bring up many more such examples.

For a genuine, supported device try a [Nucleo-F103RB](https://www.st.com/en/evaluation-tools/nucleo-f103rb.html) - note that this comes complete with a *genuine* ST-Link.

**PS:**

[Here](https://hackaday.com/2021/06/23/test-your-blue-pill-board-for-a-genuine-stm32f103c8-mcu/) is a diagnostic utility to identify what is actually fitted on your board.

#BluePill #FakeSTM32F103
